title_zh: 弃货 / 目的港费用回追

why_attention.summary_zh: 弃货与目的港费用。近 90 天紧查询抽样约 10（弃船/俚语噪声）；先前 7 天宽口径 counts=56 不可直接等同本查询。

definitions.def: Consignee fails to take delivery; cargo sits accruing storage/D&D; may be auctioned/destroyed under local rules.
THC, storage, demurrage, customs, disposal — who ultimately pays depends on contract & local recovery practice.
Industry practice of billing origin shipper/forwarder when destination party disappears — contractual, not a universal statute.

who_pays.typical: Often shipper/forwarder at origin gets chased when consignee abandons — verify BL terms & local law; experience yellow light.

official_sources.note: D&D context when cargo cannot move — still commercial

country_hooks.note: Longstanding / auction regimes vary by terminal

faq.a: 实务上常回追发货人/订舱货代，但取决于运输合同、提单条款与当地处置规则。属经验黄灯，不是单一法典条文。
收款/放单节点、信用管控文案；监控目的港费用钟——不做罚单计算。
